remarks: Be the 1st to live in this beautifully renovated 1 bedroom apartment with water views & plenty of natural light in East Norwalk. If you're looking for a walkable neighborhood, look no further. Located above the Norwalk Seaport Association office where the East Norwalk & SoNo neighborhoods meet. This apartment offers an open floorplan Living Room/Kitchen combination with plenty of cabinets, stainless appliances, and quartz countertops. One bedroom, hallway and full bath complete this apartment. High ceilings and gleaming hardwood flooring throughout. This unit is available to move-in early January 2025. Washer & dryer in unit. Located directly across from Veterans Park w/water views of the Norwalk Harbor.. Centrally located within minutes of the South Norwalk train station, shops, restaurants & nightlife, the Maritime Aquarium & Museum in Sono and all East Norwalk amenities -  Beaches, restaurants, Mr. Frosty's & the East Norwalk walk to water community.   Boater? City of Norwalk Marina & Boat launch ramps at Vets Park. Great for commuters - Minutes to South Norwalk Train Station, I-95 & Merritt Pwy.- 55 miles north of NYC.  Must have good credit. Two month's security deposit required. Parking is paid by Tenant $26.59/Month. All applications should be submitted through Rentspree. No smoking/pets.
